description: This file is an HTML document that serves as a web-based interface for visualizing database contents. It includes structure, styles, and embedded JavaScript for dynamic interactions such as loading databases, tables, and data, as well as rendering tables and handling user interactions.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Loads the list of available databases from the server and displays them in the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases by re-fetching from the server.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses the list of tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Loads and displays the tables within a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and renders data for a selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Builds and inserts an HTML table based on the data received.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Creates a table cell with special rendering for nulls, objects, and long strings.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content to show full or truncated data.
